csv_scope_of_work: CTDOT is seeking to engage ten (10) consultant engineering firms to provide task-order consultant engineering services for various structure improvement projects for the entire Division of Bridges but mainly managed under the Consultant Bridge Design. For the Bridge Management and Preservation unit, assigned consultants will evaluate, design and aid in advancement of bridge preservations projects on assigned infrastructure. The assigned consultant will work with direct CTDOT oversight to produce final deliverables. Tasks may include but are not limited to preparing design plans, estimates, specifications, coordination with DAS contractors and any necessary related data to advance preservation projects. Services may also include evaluation of existing structures prior to design, performing lifecycle cost analysis, analyzing existing data or assisting with financial analysis.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning
